scope: Static proposal arithmetic and page-coordinate reconstruction only; not a terrain generator, runtime geography, hydrology or performance acceptance.

descriptor.coordinateUnits: existing terrain tile units; no claim of metres or Earth scale
descriptor.localProjection: equirectangular tangent approximation at saved anchor; reject unsupported polar/wrap traversal until verified
descriptor.legacyPolicy: No automatic reinterpretation of freshwater/1 or coastal/1 saves; descriptor absent remains legacy
